description: This Java class `StaffWorkbookPopulator` is part of a larger project related to data import/export, specifically responsible for populating an Excel workbook with staff data, including setting up sheet layout, data validation rules, and named ranges for drop-down lists.

classes.name: StaffWorkbookPopulator
classes.description: A class responsible for creating and configuring an Excel sheet for staff data import, including setting layout, data validation, and named ranges.

methods.name: populate
methods.description: Creates the staff sheet in the workbook, populates office data, sets layout and validation rules.

methods.name: setRules
methods.description: Defines data validation rules and drop-down lists within the staff sheet for specified columns.

methods.name: setNames
methods.description: Defines named ranges in the workbook for dropdown lists, especially for office names.

methods.name: setLayout
methods.description: Sets up the header row, column sizes, and header titles for the staff sheet.
